name: STAMPED principles for reproducible research objects
description: Preprint formalizing seven principles for building and assessing research objects that others can trust, rerun and build upon: Self-containment, Tracking, Actionability, Modularity, Portability, Ephemerality and Distributability (STAMPED). Each principle is framed as a spectrum, so that adoption can be incremental, and is supported by normative requirements, an interactive checklist and a map of enabling tools.
